command:
set -e; test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || exit 77; echo ===SUBJECT===; sha256sum buehne.html buehne_daemon.py filmlook.js; echo ===LAUNCHER===; sed -n '1070,1130p' buehne_daemon.py; D=$(pgrep -f '^/usr/bin/python3 /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne_daemon.py$' | head -1); echo DAEMON=$D; echo 'sec daemon_cpu chrome_tree_cpu daemon_rss_kb chrome_rss_kb'; for i in $(seq 1 12); do DC=$(ps -p "$D" -o %cpu= | tr -d ' '); DR=$(ps -p "$D" -o rss= | tr -d ' '); read CC CR <<EOF
$(ps -eo ppid=,pcpu=,rss=,args= | awk -v d="$D" '$1==d && $0 ~ /google.chrome/ {cpu+=$2; rss+=$3} END{printf "%.1f %d",cpu,rss}')
EOF
 echo "$i ${DC:-0} ${CC:-0} ${DR:-0} ${CR:-0}"; sleep 1; done; echo ===GPU===; vulkaninfo --summary 2>/dev/null | sed -n '/GPU0:/,/GPU1:/p' | head -30; echo ===WINDOW===; xdotool search --onlyvisible --name 'FranKenstein -- live' getwindowgeometry %@ 2>/dev/null | head -30 || true
